what.text: This page follows refugees from Haiti living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 26443 Haitian refugees in France, 14.6% of all refugees from Haiti.
Brazil hosts the most Haitian refugees, followed by France, Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Haiti in 1991, in 2004 with FLRN and OP Lavalas, and again from 2024 to 2025 with Viv Ansanm.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2024 and 2025, fall in the same period as the most recent conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 2379 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
